#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353;
long long fac[200005];

long long quickPOW(long long n, long long m) {
    long long ans = 1;
    while (m > 0) {
        if (m % 2 == 1)
            ans = (ans * n) % MOD;
        n = (n * n) % MOD;
        m >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

long long C(int n, int m) {
    if (m == 0 || m == n) return 1;
    if (m > n || m < 0) return 0;
    long long res = fac[n] * quickPOW((fac[m] * fac[n - m]) % MOD, MOD - 2) % MOD;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int t = 1;
    while (t--) {
        int n;
        long long kk;
        cin >> n >> kk;
        
        fac[0] = fac[1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++)
            fac[i] = (fac[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
            
        if (kk == 0) {
            cout << fac[n] << "\n";
        } else if (kk >= n) {
            cout << 0 << "\n";
        } else {
            int k = (int) kk;
            long long tmp = 0;
            long long sign = 1;
            int l = n - k;
            for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++) {
                tmp = (tmp + MOD + (quickPOW(l - i, n) * C(l, l - i) % MOD * sign % MOD + MOD) % MOD) % MOD;
                sign *= -1;
            }
            long long res = 2 * C(n, k) % MOD * tmp % MOD;
            cout << res << "\n";
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
